aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_structure_r.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 2
aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_structure_r.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum (molten state restart or structure) and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_potential_f.name: Aluminum Potential File for Quenching - Level 2
aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_potential_f.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_quenching.name: Aluminum NPT Quenching - Level 2
aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum molten structure file and EAM potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching process of the system by cooling it under NPT. As the final output, return the final density and the absolute path to the simulation log file.

aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_tg_detectio.name: Aluminum Glass Transition Temperature Detection - Level 2
aluminum_quenching_2_subtask_tg_detectio.description: Given the path to the log file from the quenching simulation, analyze the density versus temperature data to detect the glass transition temperature (Tg). Tg is defined as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes significantly. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
